sn56.51:1.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn56.51:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo cā’yaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavīti?
sn56.51:1.4: etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ. yadidaṃ mahāpaṭhavī, appamattakoyaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.
sn56.51:1.5: saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropitoti.
sn56.51:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etadeva bahutaraṃ dukkhaṃ …pe…
sn56.51:1.8: yo “idaṃ dukkhanti” yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn56.51:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkhanti” yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
